gloss: person radical (亻); the left-hand "person" radical in kanji

definitions.gloss: person radical (亻); the left-hand "person" radical in kanji
definitions.explanation: The kanji radical {亻|にんべん}, a stylized form of {人|ひと} (person) that appears on the left side of many kanji. It is one of the most common left-side radicals ({偏|へん}) and generally signals that the kanji has some connection to people or human activity, as in {休|やす}む, {作|つく}る, {住|す}む, and {使|つか}う.

examples.japanese: 「{休|やす}」はにんべんの{漢字|かんじ}だ。
examples.english: "休" is a kanji with the person radical.

examples.japanese: にんべんは{人|ひと}に{関係|かんけい}する{漢字|かんじ}によく{使|つか}われる。
examples.english: The person radical is often used in kanji related to people.

examples.japanese: この{字|じ}のにんべんを{木|き}{偏|へん}と{間違|まちが}えないでください。
examples.english: Please don't confuse the person radical in this character with the tree radical.

examples.japanese: にんべんに「{木|き}」と{書|か}いて「{休|やす}む」と{読|よ}む。
examples.english: Write "tree" next to the person radical and it reads as "yasumu" (to rest).

notes:
The name literally means "{人|ひと}-{偏|へん}" (person-left-side-radical). にんべん is written in hiragana far more often than in kanji, because the word is usually cited when spelling out or describing a character out loud.

USAGE:
Native speakers commonly identify kanji in conversation by naming the radical plus another component: にんべんに{木|き}で「{休|やす}む」("person radical + tree = {休|やす}む"). This is a practical way to clarify which kanji you mean — for example, when giving your name over the phone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- にんべんの{漢字|かんじ}: a kanji with the person radical
- にんべんに〜: person radical next to 〜 (used when spelling kanji aloud)
- にんべんが{付|つ}く: to have the person radical attached

KANJI WITH THIS RADICAL:
Common examples include {休|やす}む (rest), {作|つく}る (make), {住|す}む (live), {使|つか}う (use), {体|からだ} (body), {代|か}わる (replace), {何|なに} (what), and many more.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- きへん: tree radical ({木|き}), a left-side radical seen in {林|はやし}, {森|もり}, {村|むら}, etc.
- {偏|へん}: the general term for any left-side radical
- {旁|つくり}: right-side component of a kanji
- {部首|ぶしゅ}: radical (general term for kanji components used in dictionary lookup)
